description:
Use this when the user wants to remove a draft post: "scrap that draft", "delete the TikTok draft". post_id
        comes from get_post_stats with status "draft". Moves the draft to Deleted posts in the RipClip planner, where the
        user can restore it for 30 days.
        Not for: scheduled or posted posts (refused), anything on a social network (nothing there is touched), clips
        or source videos (it never deletes those), or editing a draft (update_draft). Free.
name: delete_draft
title: Delete a draft
